# Get-ZbxServerStatus

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the server's system information statistics.

## SYNTAX

```
Get-ZbxServerStatus [-Server <DnsEndPoint[]>] [-Tls <ZabbixTlsMode>] [-PskIdentity <string>] [-Psk <SecureString>] [-Certificate <string>] [-CertificateKey <string>] [-CertificateAuthority <string>] [-CertificateRevocationList <string>] [-ServerIssuer <string>] [-ServerSubject <string>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxServerStatus cmdlet asks the server's trapper for the statistics the frontend's System information page shows (status.get): how many hosts, items and triggers are enabled and disabled, how many users are online, and the required values per second. It needs a Super admin's connection, whose API token the trapper accepts as the session, and the trapper in -Server or the connection's. It writes one object as the server sent it.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Read the server's statistics

```powershell
Get-ZbxServerStatus -Server 'zabbix.example:10051'
```

The object has the same sections as Reports > System information.

### Example 2: Show every section of the statistics

```powershell
Get-ZbxServerStatus -Server 'zabbix.example:10051' | Format-List
```

Format-List shows each section the server sent on its own line.

## PARAMETERS

### -Server

The server's trapper: host or host:port (port 10051 when omitted; an IPv6 address with a port is bracketed, [::1]:10051). Several are the nodes of one HA cluster, tried in order. The connection's (Connect-ZbxServer -Trapper), else the active HA node's, when omitted.

### -Tls

How the connection to the trapper is protected (Zabbix's TLSConnect): Unencrypted, PreSharedKey (or psk) or Certificate (or cert). When omitted, PreSharedKey if -Psk or -PskIdentity is given, Certificate if a certificate parameter is; with no TLS parameter at all, the connection's (Connect-ZbxServer -TrapperTls), unencrypted when it has none.
